The show_pwq() function dumps out a pool_workqueue structure's activity
Showing busy workqueues and worker pools:
pwq 0: cpus=0 node=0 flags=0x1 nice=0 active=10/256 refcnt=11
When large systems are facing certain types of hang conditions
unusual for this ""pending"" list to contain runs of hundreds of identical
function names.  This ""wall of text"" is difficult to read
it can be interleaved with other output such as stack traces.

column2: make show_pwq() use run-length encoding so that the above

column1: Showing busy workqueues and worker pools:
pwq 0: cpus=0 node=0 flags=0x1 nice=0 active=10/256 refcnt=11
When no comma would be printed
a new run is started unconditionally.

column2: places less stress on the hardware
and software on the console-log path
